title: Time-series model tests sepsis prediction with an indeterminate option
summary: An attention-based LSTM evaluated hospital-record sepsis labels retrospectively. External-dataset AUC was 0.971 six hours before recorded onset; withholding uncertain classifications reduced false positives. This does not establish improved care or prospective non-ICU performance.
ai_technology: Attention-based long short-term memory neural network; conformal prediction

evidence.tested: MIMIC-IV development and eICU-CRD retrospective evaluation. The November2024 preprint already reports this result; peer-reviewed version followed in May2025.
evidence.unknown: External labels used diagnosis strings rather than Sepsis-3. About 17% were indeterminate. Missingness eligibility used the six-hour window even for earlier forecasts. ICU-onset cases were included; preprocessing isolation is incompletely documented. No measured workflow benefit.
evidence.ai_role: The LSTM learns laboratory trajectories; conformal sets flag unfamiliar inputs.

source_review.scope: Exact primary metadata/version relationship; indexed primary clinical/model Methods, Results and limitations.
